subject: htmlTemplate not reflecting changes on page refresh

messages.author: aee3e25f4c0afac7
messages.subject: htmlTemplate not reflecting changes on page refresh
parts:
Hi all,

I've been trying out the new htmlTemplate, but as I make updates in the template.html file (and no changes in the ui.R or server.R file), these changes aren't pushed to the running shiny application until I make some arbitrary change in one of the .R files. Is there anything I missed or can do to have the application pickup on changes in the template.html file?

Thanks,
Jack

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: htmlTemplate not reflecting changes on page refresh
parts:
Ah, good point. There are two things you could do:

1) Wrap your UI definition with function(req) { ... }. So for example, if you have this:

# ui.R
htmlTemplate(...)

Instead you would replace it with:

# ui.R
function(req) {
  htmlTemplate(...)
}

This will prevent the caching from happening. Oh, if you're using the (vestigial) shinyUI function then it would look like:

shinyUI(function(req) {
  htmlTemplate(...)
})

2) Leave things the way they are, but before launching, call options(shiny.autoreload=TRUE). I believe this should make it so saving your HTML template will immediately cause the app to reload, no need to even refresh your browser (unless there's an error in your template, then you'll still need to manually reload).
